tiers.label: Street food / local stall
tiers.notes: Common Thai one-dish meals at street stalls and local markets are often under 100 THB; tourist zones can be higher.

tiers.label: Local casual restaurant
tiers.notes: Casual local restaurants often sit above street stalls but below premium mall or destination restaurants.

tiers.label: Mall food court
tiers.notes: Bangkok food courts can be close to street-food pricing; premium malls and food halls vary by venue.

tiers.label: Department-store or higher-end mall restaurant
tiers.notes: Higher-end mall food halls and sit-down restaurants can cost much more than street stalls.

tiers.label: Premium/famous venue
tiers.notes: Destination venues, Michelin-listed street food, seafood-heavy dishes, and special ingredients can be unusually expensive; price transparency still matters.

dish_hints.price_multiplier_note: Seafood-heavy dishes can sit above normal local dish prices, especially at famous venues.
A normal omelette is usually inexpensive, but crab omelette at a famous seafood venue can be premium.

sources.title: Numbeo: Cost of Living in Bangkok restaurant prices
sources.summary: Meal at an inexpensive restaurant around 120 THB, range 65-200 THB; meal for two at a mid-range restaurant around 1,200 THB, range 650-2,000 THB.

sources.title: NomadAgent: Thailand street food prices 2026
sources.summary: Street food dishes commonly around 40-100 THB in 2026, with many common dishes listed in the 40-100 THB band.

sources.title: Visual Thailand: Cheapest food courts in Bangkok 2026
sources.summary: Food court meal ranges include 30-60 THB at Pier 21 and 60-120 THB at several other Bangkok mall food courts.

sources.title: HealMatch: MBK Center food court price ranges
sources.summary: Approximate Bangkok mall food-court ranges include MBK 25-80 THB, CentralWorld 45-130 THB, Siam Paragon Gourmet Eats 150-350 THB, EmQuartier Food Hall 120-300 THB.

sources.title: Bangkok Post: Jay Fai crab omelette pricing complaint
sources.summary: Jay Fai case reported a 1,500 THB listed crab omelette and 4,000 THB premium version pricing issue, emphasizing displayed-price clarity.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide: Jay Fai Bangkok
sources.summary: Jay Fai is listed as a one-star, high-quality Bangkok street-food restaurant with signature crab omelettes.
